name: Message in a Bottle
summary: The message in a bottle brings you to an island off the Stranglethorn coast, where Princess Poobah waits in chains. King Mukla commands the island’s beasts and keeps her captive. To free her, you need the key to her shackle.

sections.title: A Captive on the Isle
sections.body: On an island off the Stranglethorn coast, Princess Poobah waits in chains. The message in the bottle has brought you to her. King Mukla is a great Skymane gorilla who commands the creatures roaming the island. He keeps Poobah imprisoned, and she trusts you to face the ape and bring back her shackle key.

sections.title: The Beast to the Southeast
sections.body: Princess Poobah says her captor often prowls the island’s southeastern side. King Mukla is a formidable foe. Defeating him is the only way to claim the shackle key and free Poobah.

sections.title: Deliverance and Gratitude
sections.body: The key frees Princess Poobah from her chains and saves her from what she sees as a deep dishonor. She cannot grant you full induction into her tribe. Instead, she offers a token of thanks for your courage.

faq.answer: Princess Poobah is a tribal captive chained on an island off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. She sent out a plea in a bottle and waits for someone daring enough to overcome her captor and unlock her shackle.
King Mukla holds Princess Poobah captive. He is a massive Skymane gorilla who commands the beasts around him on the island.
Princess Poobah says King Mukla often prowls the southeastern side of the island.

faq.q: What is needed to free Princess Poobah?
faq.answer: To free Princess Poobah, defeat King Mukla and take the key to her shackle. Bring it back to unlock her chain.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the story?
faq.answer: This follows the plea found in a bottle and brings you face to face with King Mukla. You can then free Princess Poobah from her chains.
